description: M179 (D150, R-db9dec62): the 31 comments relayed to the team by hand between 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-16, loaded into Feedback as relayed reports by `php scripts/feedback-pull.php --relay=database/data/feedback/relayed-2026-10.json --tenant=<slug> --user-approved` (ADR-0023 section D7). Title, status and note are the text the user approved on 2026-10-19 (plan V, section E); each remark quotes the original comment (… marks a part addressed to the development session rather than about the app). The repository is public (D48): no email address and no person's name belongs in this file — the workspace and the reporter are named on the command line. Re-running the file changes words only, never a status.

items.title: “This item changed elsewhere” when nothing did
items.note: Fixed in version a5b718b, live on staging.
items.source_label: The testers' PDF of Oct 11, comment 5
items.remarks: “Good that a prompt shows when changes are implemented but notation on changes are not specific. Example, after creating a field, I only changed the ‘requiredness’ of the field but it was not shown in the prompt (see image below). I think, it will also be bothersome if this occurs for every field modification. I think it is best to have a ledger/list/log of the nitty-gritty changes per field (backend) instead of a prompt for each change for monitoring purposes. An option to revert changes on each of the field modification would also be beneficial. Revert changes should state what the previous state was before applying reversal (this can be another module).”
